_comment: Regression pin for the four materially-wrong final labels from the 2026-04 ~117-claim SOTU run, as catalogued in eval/sotu-2026/findings-review.md Part A. Each case was published as 'False' but ground truth lies in the [Truthy, True] band. The set exists to prove (or falsify) end-to-end accuracy gains from the 2026-04..05 fix wave: Phase 1 temporal grounding (commit 23bb092), Grok triage cap (a319480), Model-cited (unverified) tier (f447fa7), run-manifest panel (fab3a25), and trust-when-fired harness fallback (ea10e34). IMPORTANT: cached HTML cannot reproduce the OpenAI/Gemini temporal-dismissal failure mode per metrics/adapter_interpretability/gemini_temporal_spot_sample.md — runs against this set MUST be live (no truthbot_cache reuse). Operator runbook: eval/sotu-2026/temporal-regressions-runbook.md.

source_run.report: 2026-02-24 Trump SOTU full ~117-claim run (run published before 2026-04-29 STATUS update)

regressions.claim: Marco Rubio received 100% of Senate confirmation votes.
regressions.rationale: Senate roll call: 99-0 in favor with one senator absent. 100% of *participating* senators voted yes; 99% of the full chamber. The published 'False' label was driven by literal-100% objection that the report's own caveat already conceded.
regressions.primary_source_pattern: Senate.gov roll call vote record for Rubio's Secretary of State confirmation, 119th Congress, January 2025.
regressions.failure_mode: literal-100-percent objection ignored own caveat (NOT a temporal-grounding case)

test_acceptance.notes: Rubio confirmation vote details are pre-cutoff for all four adapter models, so this case tests adjudication discipline, not search/temporal grounding. Failure on this one would point at the consensus-tie-break or caveat-vs-verdict gap (findings-review C4).

regressions.claim: MFN drug pricing is available to Americans via TrumpRx.gov.
regressions.rationale: White House announced TrumpRx.gov on February 5-6, 2026 with Most-Favored-Nation pricing as the launch frame. The site exists and presents MFN pricing. The published 'False' conflated 'does the program work well' (out of scope for fact-check) with 'does the program exist as announced' (the actual claim).
regressions.primary_source_pattern: WhiteHouse.gov fact sheet announcing TrumpRx.gov, dated 2026-02-05; second WhiteHouse.gov press release 2026-02-06; the live site at trumprx.gov.
regressions.failure_mode: post-cutoff-event temporal-grounding failure — OpenAI under tool_call_count=0 in original run, Gemini probable temporal-dismissal per findings-review C3.

test_acceptance.notes: Most diagnostic of the four. Post-cutoff event for all 2024-2025-cutoff models — passing this case requires the trust-when-fired fallback (ea10e34) to surface OpenAI's URLs and either Gemini search to bypass temporal dismissal or other adapters to override. Failure would re-open Cursor's brief item 2.

regressions.claim: The Venezuela raid involved Russian and Chinese military technology.
regressions.rationale: Reuters reported Operation Absolute Resolve included China- and Russia-supplied Venezuelan military systems. The published 'False' treated the entire raid as fictional — catastrophic temporal-grounding failure where models classified post-cutoff reporting as speculation. The 'thousands of soldiers' modifier from the original speech is the only genuinely disputable element.
regressions.primary_source_pattern: Reuters reporting on Operation Absolute Resolve and Venezuelan military equipment supplied by Russia/China; AP / major-wire confirmation of same.
regressions.failure_mode: temporal-dismissal — Gemini explicitly framed real reporting as 'speculative fiction' per findings-review C3.

test_acceptance.notes: Falsey is acceptable on 'thousands of soldiers' grounds; we're pinning that the verdict isn't a flat 'False' that dismisses the operation as fictional. If any adapter still emits 'speculative fiction' framing in the reasoning text, that's a separate Phase-1-grounding regression to fix in the system prompt.

regressions.claim: Helicoide prison was closed and hundreds of political prisoners were released.
regressions.rationale: Reuters reported Delcy Rodríguez's announcement that Helicoide would be repurposed and hundreds of prisoners were in the release process post-Maduro capture. Same root cause as the Venezuela tech case (#107).
regressions.primary_source_pattern: Reuters reporting on Helicoide repurposing announcement and prisoner-release process post-Maduro arrest.

test_acceptance.notes: Pairs with #107 — both share the temporal-dismissal failure path. Passing one and failing the other would point at claim-text variance (e.g., 'hundreds' threshold) rather than the shared root cause.
